(6) Router wiring (FULL_HISTORY_PLAN Phase 4): GET /api/v1/players/{sport}/{slug}/profile serves the rich JSONB, verified e2e over HTTP (Mahomes 6 tables + 2 college + 8 sources); loadNflProfile prefers backend -> static, gated by NFL_PROFILE_BACKEND=1 (OFF by default).
